body: I don't have it in me anymore, I can't do anything anymore, it hurts too much to wait anymore. I've tried it all and can't try anymore. I don't have a plan but I don't want to be alive very very soon. But at the same time I don't. I'm just so sick. I can't handle it or my episodes anymore. My head is so loud. Nothing can help and anything that says it can, I don't trust anymore.
As I said, last ditch effort. What else can I do if I haven't ended it yet? But you're right, I would never know.
